pages.text: Put a $(item)Station$() beside the track, like a signal. $(l)Click$() it to name it (or name it in an anvil first) and set how long timetabled trains wait there, 2 to 120 seconds.$(br2)Trains on a timetable stop with their front level with its nameboard. It gives a redstone signal while a train is standing at it: handy for doors, lamps or a bell.
